speaker.name: Efficiency Emilia
speaker.role: Uses deep domain knowledge to define business goals, objectives, and KPIs. Aligns ML features with overarching product strategy and organizational roadmaps. Evaluates system performance, operational capability, and project costs.

output.objection: You are cutting our drift detection to pay for alerts, which hides the real cost of silent model failure. We need you to acknowledge that this trade off shifts risk from the infrastructure budget to our operational floor.
output.correction: I did not suggest pausing the tool to save money for its own sake. I only accept the pause if the savings fully cover the new alerting service, so the net spend stays flat while we fix the blind spot.
